title: Weekday earliest start
text: Regular weekday classes may not start before 4:45 PM unless a level-specific exception applies.

review.original_text: Regular weekday classes may not start before 4:30 PM.
review.correction_raw: Regular weekday classes may not start before 4:45 PM unless a level-specific exception applies.

title: Preferred weekday start
text: Only Elementary 1, Elementary 2, Level 4B, and 4B/5 levels may start at 4:30 PM. 4:45 PM remains the preferred normal weekday start time.

review.original_text: When there is no reason to use 4:30 PM, 4:45 PM is the preferred normal weekday start time.
review.correction_raw: Only Elem 1, Elem 2, 4B, 4B/5 levels may start at 4:30, but 4:45 is the preferred normal weekday start time

title: Normal weekday latest finish
text: Regular weekday classes must finish by 9:30 PM unless a level-specific exception applies.

title: Level 5 weekday finish exception
text: Level 5 classes may finish as late as 9:45 PM.

title: Saturday earliest start
text: Saturday classes may not start before 9:00 AM.

title: Saturday closing time
text: Saturday has a HARD closing time of 3:00 PM.

review.original_text: No hard latest Saturday finish is currently defined; Saturday may run later than the current schedule when necessary.
review.correction_raw: Saturday has a hard closing time of 3:00pm

title: No Sunday regular classes
text: No regular weekly classes are scheduled on Sunday; Sunday is reserved for competitive/company work.

title: No room double-booking
text: A studio room may not host two classes at the same time.

title: No teacher double-booking
text: A teacher may not teach two classes at the same time.

title: No dancer double-booking
text: A dancer may not be scheduled into two required classes at the same time.

title: No reset buffer required
text: Classes may run directly back-to-back; no room reset/setup buffer is required.

title: No teacher transition buffer required
text: Teachers may teach back-to-back classes without a transition buffer within the studio.

title: Teacher same-day maximum gap
text: A teacher's gap between consecutive classes on the same working day may not exceed 60 minutes.

title: Dancer same-day maximum gap
text: A dancer's gap between consecutive classes on the same attendance day may not exceed 60 minutes.

title: Avoid isolated teacher workdays
text: Aimee, Cami, Karly, Denise, and Sydni must teach more than one class on any day they teach. For all other teachers, avoid bringing them in for only one class when a reasonable alternative exists.

review.original_text: Avoid bringing a teacher in for only one class when a reasonable alternative exists.
review.correction_raw: Aimee, Cami, Karly, Denise, and Sydni must have more than one class on a given day. for allother teachers, Avoid bringing them in for only one class when a reasonable alternative exists.
